visualReview.fiveArtworks: Reviewed the whole quail, cottontail, poppy with connected bud and leaves, corrected four-legged lizard, and pair of meadow mushrooms in the full sheet and all actual encoded 85 px tiles. Each singular subject and the three broad muted shadows remain legible against stone. The exact original quail is unchanged. One direct own-source edit removed a stray small lizard foot below the tail; four connected legs and all three cast lobes remain.
visualReview.wallpaper: Reviewed all three actual encoded phone profiles. Each shows the full quail and crest, rabbit and long ears, planted poppy and bud, lizard and complete curling tail, and whole pair of mushrooms. The quail's projected shadows are the clearest at this scale. Some companion shadow tips approach the side edges of the wide group, about 98 percent with the casts, without visually clipping the major subjects or cast shapes. The open top remains quiet. The one original wallpaper uses the exact quail as sole reference.

Ornament parsing and battery boundary states pass.
